content:
Hi! First mathlib PR; small scope and CI green.
PR: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36700
(addresses #34959)
Adds SimpleGraph.matchingNumber : ℕ∞ and one lemma Subgraph.IsMatching.edgeSet_encard_le_matchingNumber.
AI used for drafting; I reviewed/understand the final code and can vouch for it.

That issue already has someone assigned to it, and they have a pretty cool PR for it (#36274), which subsumes your PR.
Can you clarify your intentions with this additional PR?
Also generally Mathlib doesn't like adding definitions without some API, and I don't think that single lemma is enough.

Adam Parks said:

AI used for drafting; I reviewed/understand the final code and can vouch for it.

Your PR description is longer than the code, which strikes me as odd

Thanks, that's very helpful. My intention here was to make a tiny first contribution and learn the workflow; I missed that #34959 already had an assigned in-flight PR in #36274. Given that and the point about the API being too thin, I'll close #36700 rather than duplicate work. I appreciate the guidance.
